title: Function Tunnel Networks (FTN): A Structural Perspective on Intelligence, Education, Division of Labor, and Human-AI Co-Evolution
description: Function Tunnel Networks (FTN) is an open research framework investigating how stable functional pathways shape intelligence, learning, specialization, education, division of labor, comparative advantage, and Human-AI collaboration. Building upon Function Tunnel Intelligence (FTI), the FTN framework introduces the concepts of Function Tunnel Networks and Function Tunnel Capital (FTC) to explain how capabilities emerge, accumulate, and evolve across individuals, organizations, societies, and Human-AI systems. The repository explores Function Tunnels as operational structures rather than metaphors, emphasizing trajectory families, feasible evolution regions, educational tunnel engineering, social specialization, collective intelligence, and future Human-AI co-evolution.
